name: ChatGPT Slides
desc: Make and co-edit a slide deck inside ChatGPT, then export it.
desc_zh: 在 ChatGPT 里边聊边做幻灯片，多人同时改，做完导出。
solves: A deck dies in the copy-paste between the chat and the slide app. Slides stays editable, exports to PowerPoint or Google Slides, and lets teammates comment in place.
solves_zh: 演示稿往往死在聊天窗口和幻灯片软件之间的反复拷贝。Slides 全程可编辑，能导出到 PowerPoint 或 Google Slides，同事可以直接在页面上留言。
best_for: You have notes and an outline, and a deck due before the meeting.
best_for_zh: 你手里有笔记和大纲，而演示稿开会前就要。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI DevDay 2026 recap, https://openai.com/index/devday-2026-recap）。 DevDay on 2026-09-29 already listed "Collaborative slides" as available to all Pro, Business and Enterprise plans, so first availability is taken as 2026-09-29; the release notes describe the wider rollout under 2026-10-16. Requires Space access. 首次公开日期来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
